pairs.l: 5 — they were forbidden to be with?

r1.exp: 1=C (Caryn: 'I DECIDED WE SHOULDN'T HANG OUT ANY MORE'). 2=E (Edmund: 'he got a place at university and DISAPPEARED FROM MY LIFE'). 3=F (Frieda: 'She was, for all of us, AN ENIGMA'). 4=E (Edmund: 'They thought it was WEIRD THAT HE'D WANT TO BE WITH SOMEONE SO MUCH YOUNGER'). 5=E (Edmund: 'MY PARENTS SAID THAT I WASN'T TO SEE HIM'). 6=A (Archie: 'Gavin was sort of MY HERO'). 7=D (Daren: 'RACE you to the corner... I'd dare him who could climb higher'). 8=F (Frieda: 'Walking along the canal after dark... up in a tree'). 9=B (Becky: 'She had been SHOT IN THE HIP by Imperial Stormtroopers' = Clara's strange walk = physical disability). 10=A (Archie: 'Gavin RAN OFF LEAVING ME BEHIND'). 11=B (Becky: 'stories POURED OUT OF HER... There was NEVER A MOMENT'S SILENCE'). 12=D (Daren: 'he supported his home team, BAYERN MUNICH' = German, Robert's father got job in SAUDI ARABIA = foreigner).

r13.exp: 'It was late... this app started in MY LONDON BEDROOM' = kod kuće = C.

r14.exp: 'I had the BRAINWAVE' = trenutak inspiracije = A.

r15.exp: 'Google clicking was TAKING TOO MUCH TIME... needed a way of SIMPLIFYING web searches' = učiniti učenje efikasnijim = B.

r16.exp: 'You have NOTHING TO LOSE, so just go and TAKE A RISK' = ne brini se zbog neuspjeha = A.

r17.exp: 'It was his HOBBY that took him to the world of algorithms' = slobodne aktivnosti = C.

r18.exp: 'It is a journey that HAS ONLY JUST STARTED' = samo je početak = D.

r19.exp: 'Our rationality came to define us. (19)_____. It was considered a characteristic that put us ABOVE ANIMALS.' → D: It was, simply put, WHAT MADE US HUMAN.

r20.exp: 'Many brain areas involve emotions. (20)_____. Even when we try to be reasonable, emotional impulses influence judgement.' → F: Whenever we make a decision, the brain is subject to FEELINGS AND PASSIONS.

r21.exp: 'Elliot lost ability to experience emotion. (21)_____. It followed that a person without emotions should make rational decisions.' → C: At the time, scientists ASSUMED THAT OUR EMOTIONS WERE IRRATIONAL.

r22.exp: 'All this analysis was for nothing. (22)_____. Emotions are necessary for decision making.' → E: He STILL DIDN'T KNOW WHAT TO DO.

r23.exp: 'Why do we eat too much, spend too much? (23)_____. When emotions get out of control, results are devastating.' → A: It's because we're LISTENING TO OUR EMOTIONAL BRAIN instead of thinking rationally.

r24.exp: 'Pain of loss twice as strong as pleasure of gain. (24)_____. Losses loom larger than gains.' → G: People's decisions seemed to be DETERMINED BY THESE FEELINGS. 'These feelings' = the asymmetric pain/pleasure responses.

r25.exp: 'Iraheta DROPPED out of school in 10th grade' — frazalni glagol 'drop out (of school)' = napustiti školu prije kraja. 'Left out of school' nije idiomatski (left out = izostavljen).

r26.exp: 'A LACK of employment opportunities' — fiksna kolokacija: lack of = nedostatak.

r27.exp: 'BY most accounts' — fiksni izraz: by all/most accounts = prema svim/većini mišljenja.

r28.exp: 'In the PAST few years' — fiksni izraz: in the past few years = u posljednjih nekoliko godina.

r29.exp: 'Then something CHANGED' — past simple za narativni slijed u prošlosti (2000 → then it changed).

r30.exp: 'Had dropped BY more than 1.5 million' — prijedlog 'by' za iznos smanjenja (dropped by X = palo za X).

r31.exp: 'Unlikely to land positions – BECAUSE they are up against more experienced workers' — 'because' za uzrok/razlog.

r32.exp: '42 enrolled; NONETHELESS, only 11 found jobs' — 'nonetheless' za kontrast (unatoč tome = only 11 found work).

r33.exp: 'Less LIKELY/PRONE to die' — 'less likely to' = manje vjerojatno; 'less prone to' = manje sklono.

r34.exp: 'Include heart disease... BUT/THOUGH/ALTHOUGH not cancer' — kontrast: uključuje X, ali ne Y.

r35.exp: 'Taking PART in a diet and health study' — fiksna kolokacija: take part in = sudjelovati u.

r36.exp: 'Classified ACCORDING to the amount of coffee' — fiksni izraz: according to = prema.

r37.exp: 'Drinking UP to six cups a day' — fiksni izraz: up to = do, najviše.

r38.exp: 'An inverse association, WHICH means those drinking more had reduced risk' — ne-restriktivna relativna zamjenica 'which' (uz zarez).

r39.exp: 'But THERE are biological effects from antioxidants' — 'there are' za egzistencijalnu konstrukciju.

r40.exp: 'The MORE coffee you drink, the longer you will live' — komparativna konstrukcija: the more... the more/longer.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA online kupovinu: udobnost, ušteda vremena, širi izbor, usporedba cijena, dostava. PROTIV: ne možeš isprobati, čekanje dostave, povrat, sigurnost podataka, socijalni aspekt kupovine. Vlastito mišljenje.
